notes.title: HUB, missions, mods and lot of other things...
notes.content:
/!\ It's recommanded to reset your save fil to continue with this version! /!\
- rebuild of the HUB in progress
- add an animation for the excavator
- add the spy lodge
- add the night missions
- mellings have now a custom shape size, to provide more different styles
- change the way ennemy stats and quantity was calculated
- add a neutral faction you can encounter in missions: phyto
- add prospector, in exploration lodge
- add supply missions
- some stats, like gardians posts number, cannot be upgraded with mellings workers
- add a mellings role: repair technicians, you can obtain while building the expert lodge
- the expert lodge, bringing this new repair technician, no longer bring study bonus directly
- Aim reticule can now have custom color and opacity

notes.title: Map difficulty and more...
notes.content:
- The ennemies now grow up their stats and quantity, depending on the time spent on map and buildings destroyed
- Add a bonus to the supply looted while expanding the map size
- The Xaris have now their own miniboss
- The Cantina is now avaible! You can recruit your very first melling crew!
- Lot of little changes

notes.title: Mini boss and special missions
notes.content:
- Added mini boss that loot boxes with special mission upgrades
- Added special missions, only rescue mission for now

notes.title: Study update
notes.content:
Now, the upgrades are increased by studying one. Percent of study increase "randomly" while obtaining supply.
... and lot of improvements!

notes.title: blueprints acquisition change
notes.content:
Change the way to up blueprints:
- First you can choose the upgrade to "research"
- Then you obtain % of the chosen blueprint while obtaining supply

The percent obtained is, for now 1 supply = 1 % but it will change, with progression feedbacks

notes.title: feedbacks and resolutions
notes.content:
Add visual feedbacks
Change some UI to support more screen resolutions
Some fixes and little changes
Change graphic shader to make it shinier

notes.title: interface and story
notes.content:
. add new story line at the end of the first battle
. change aiming reticule
. add new camera move on unlocking new building
. lot of fixes

notes.title: tuto & mellings
notes.content:
Add tutorials
Add mellings using in upgrade menus

notes.content:

Basic gameplay is here and some menuing is accessible...
